title: Change file frontmatter, version 1
description: The YAML frontmatter of a change file under the requirements folder's changes/. Each entry states a requirement the change leaves behind, in full. An entry that does not match accounts for nothing. Omit requirements when the change touches none.

renumberedFrom.description: The id this requirement had before a renumber. Of the same type as id, and different from it.

statement.description: The resulting statement, word for word.

scenarios.description: Every scenario the requirement has, each once. Left out when it has none.
